reason_code_definitions.sig_resolution_text_missing: SIG Info-tab resolution text for this market is not captured and reviewed, so the settlement condition, source and timing cannot be compared with any venue.
reason_code_definitions.sig_race_identity_unverified: No authoritative SIG race or stage ID is in reviewed inputs; the race key is a title-derived proposal, and regular versus special election is unknown.
reason_code_definitions.venue_snapshot_fails_current_s1t5_valida: The frozen venue output fails the S1-T5 validator on main, so its labels are not trusted and its contents are used for candidate discovery only.
reason_code_definitions.venue_coverage_incomplete: The frozen venue output does not cover the whole venue, so absence of a counterpart from it is unresolved, never a no-match.
reason_code_definitions.pending_reviewer_decision: No authorized reviewer has decided this pair; candidates in markets/r1_candidates.json are algorithmic suggestions only.
